Earlier gameplay summary (agent-written, uncertain claims remain uncertain):
CONTROLS (observed): WASD move, mouse L/R click, Left Alt inspect, Left Ctrl/F attack, Space action, Q/E rotate, wheel zoom, Tab toggles map, Esc pause (Continue/Controls/Settings/Save&Quit). Number keys trigger the hotbar slot's native action (verified: ate food; relit a stowed torch). Left-edge crafting bar icons can be clicked directly; Caps Lock 'Open Crafting' couldn't be triggered with allowed keys.

CRAFTING UI: left vertical category icons at x≈0.024 (axe/tools y≈0.05-0.14, flame/light y≈0.16-0.20, rope y≈0.25, Science y≈0.42, sword y≈0.55). Clicking opens a plaque column at x≈0.10; plaque rows drift between openings (~0.06-0.08 apart) — always verify the recipe card title. Card shows have/need counts and a Build button ~(0.28,0.66); grey when short; Build closes panel. Hovering sometimes swaps cards, sometimes clicking is needed, sometimes the card just closes — method uncertain and each attempt costs torch fuel at night. TORCH = 2 grass + 2 twigs ('A portable light source'); crafting AUTO-EQUIPS AND AUTO-LIGHTS it, so craft near dusk, not in daylight. Campfire = 3 grass + 2 logs; Fire Pit = 2 logs + 12 rocks (Build always grey; logs never obtained). The card's have/need numbers are the reliable inventory check — hotbar digit glyphs misled me (a 3-count item was not grass).

RESOURCES: distant clicks are two-stage (first walks, second picks); re-hover each frame since sprites drift with the camera. 'Pick Grass' = tall spiky pale/golden blades; 'Examine Grass' = short harvested stub. 'Pick Sapling' = small bare twiggy bush (1 twig); 'Examine Sapling' harvested. Curved ground sticks are harvested stumps, never pickups. Tall spindly bare trees are evergreens ('Examine Evergreen'). Yellow slivers hugging evergreen trunks are part of the tree sprite (no tooltip) — not grass. Berry bushes show red dots when ripe ('Pick Berry Bush' → 1 berry); harvested ones read 'Examine Berry Bush' and do regrow within roughly a day. 'Pick Carrot' plants are golden spiky tufts easily mistaken for grass. 'Pick up Flint' = pale grey shards. Flowers give petals. Red mushrooms are pickable ('Pick Red Mushroom') but edibility untested; mushroom/carrot pickups sometimes ended up held in hand and took many clicks to bank, and a 'Drop' label once appeared when clicking a held item — avoid clicking held-item labels. Fireflies (probably net-only), butterflies, crows, cardinals, rabbits are not resources; clicking an overlapping creature can trigger an attack ('That'll teach him.').

DANGERS: dusk message 'It's getting late. It will be dark soon.'; darkness with no light gave 'What was that?!' then sometimes 'OW! Something hit me!' with red vignette and damage — but other nights passed unharmed, so darkness damage is sporadic/conditional. Spiders bite and pursue. Red hounds are hostile (sometimes idle/asleep); dead hound carcasses are inert and unharvestable. Red vignette = taking hits. Fleeing (walking/running away) beats unarmed fighting. KEY ERROR SOURCE: golden sprites adjacent to the character (lit-torch flame, character-held items, green blades underfoot) follow the character — never target them; verify a resource stays put when the character moves.

NAVIGATION/BIOMES: Map (Tab) shows one small explored patch, rest black. Spawn forest gets picked clean over days; fresh tufts/saplings concentrate in unvisited turf and at biome edges. Savanna lies north/north-east (tufts, boulders); rocky biome east; sandy dunes with rabbits further east; a rocky/snowy bluff north (resource dead end); ocean far south. Cardinals/reeds near boundaries. Trunks/canopies intercept pointers — approach so the target sprite is exposed and aim at exposed pixels.

FAILED STRATEGIES: clicking crafting icons too far right; expecting ground sticks to be pickups; gathering twigs after nightfall instead of in daylight; wandering while the torch burned; attacking spiders/hounds bare-handed; trusting stubs as fresh grass; chasing the character's own flame; many craft-UI clicks in darkness (each drains torch); assuming plaque rows stay put.

SURVIVAL PRIORITIES LEARNED: early each day bank 2 grass + 2 twigs (twigs are the chronic bottleneck, saplings sparse near spawn — harvest every one); craft a spare torch toward dusk; when the light dies press the stowed torch's slot key to relight (works; relight only when no torch burns); eat at the first 'I'm so hungry!' warning (a single berry barely helps; carrots/berries stock); flee hostile creatures; crafting works in darkness and has repeatedly rescued runs.

UNRESOLVED/UNCERTAIN: exact night-damage mechanics; mushroom edibility; regrow timing for berries/carrots; whether/how logs are obtainable (Campfire, Fire Pit); purpose of petals, flowers, rabbits; the 'S'-scroll plaques and Science tab; identity of a red spiky bird-like creature seen on the rock slab (hovering 'Attack' prompt appeared with hound); whether killing hounds yields anything.
